name: LG U+ Daejeon IDC
notes: LG U+ official nationwide IDC list (16 centers): Daejeon center at Gyeryong-ro 553beon-gil 66, Seo-gu (Tanbang-dong 663, LG U+ building 3F). Commercial colocation, operational.

name: NIRS Daejeon main center (National Information Resources Service)
developer: NIRS / Ministry of Interior and Safety (government)
notes: Flagship government datacenter (Gukjeong Jawon) in Daejeon Yuseong-gu; hosts core government digital services. Major lithium-battery fire 2025-09-26 during UPS replacement on 5F server floor; ~647 government services disrupted; recovery ongoing. Public-sector DC, not commercial colo.

name: NAVER Data Center GAK Chuncheon
notes: NAVER's first in-house hyperscale datacenter, Dong-myeon Chuncheon (Sunhwan-daero 1154-79); operational since 2018; anchors Oracle ap-chuncheon-1 cloud region. First-party official page.

name: Samsung C&T Chuncheon Data Center
notes: Building permit processed 2026-07-28 for DC at Chiljeon-dong urban high-tech industrial complex; construction area 1,646 sqm; KRW ~60bn investment; 2.4MW scale; modular method; construction from Aug 2026, completion target H2 2028 (Yonhap citing Chuncheon mayor). First datacenter project in Gangwon pursued this way.

name: Oracle Cloud Chuncheon region (ap-chuncheon-1)
notes: Official Oracle cloud region South Korea North (Chuncheon); region/AZ existence is official; physical facilities undisclosed (methodology anchor).

name: GS Donghae AI Data Center
notes: GS Group pursuing 2.4GW-class AI datacenter in Donghae as part of government AI mega-project (1st phase announced: SK Ulsan 1GW, GS Donghae 2.4GW, NAVER Sejong 1GW). Donghae city formed AI DC TF (2026); first 100MW phase targeted to break ground 2026 and complete 2027 (G1TV). Announcement/TF stage; no permit or land evidence yet - treat as intent.

name: Gangneung AI Data Center
notes: Groundbreaking 2026-03-26 at Gangdong-myeon, Aninjin-ri 300-31; total 5 phases, phase 1 KRW 1.4tn (~1GW class per KBS) targeting 2028 completion; end-user/tenant undisclosed ('user confidential'); flagship Gangwon AI hub and 2026 election issue. Capacity per phase not officially published - phase 1 ~1GW class per press.

name: Wonju IDC (Wonju Enterprise City Data Center)
developer: Wonju IDC Co. + Like Asset Management
notes: 60MW-class commercial DC in Wonju Enterprise City; investment/business agreement signed 2023-12-12 with Wonju city (Wonju IDC, Like Asset Mgmt); land acquired Jun 2023, permits completed Dec 2023; plan was construction H1 2024 / completion H2 2026; selected among 10 gov data-center candidate projects (Oct 2023, with KEPCO). 2023-era schedule - verify current construction status.
